input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. It exposes interfaces for managing weather service. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to interact with weather service functionality, so that I can accomplish my weather service-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Developer, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a Admin, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
